name: Haroon Meer
biography: is the Technical Director of SensePost. He joined SensePost in 2001 and has not slept since his early childhood. He has co-authored several technical books on Information Security and has spoken and trained at conferences around the world (BlackHat, Defcon, DeepSec, MS-Tech-Ed, Recon, etc). He has played in most aspects of IT Security from development to deployment and currently gets his kicks from reverse engineering, application assessments and similar forms of pain.
